item.title: The White House is already one of the most blocked accounts on Bluesky
item.description:
📝 The Trump administration is taking its social media attacks on Democratic opponents to an unlikely platform, with the White House and numerous other government agencies joining Bluesky on Friday. And Bluesky users delivered, with many responses to the initial White House post bringing up Trump’s relationship with infamous sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. Bring them along and save 60% on their pass.

item.title: Ask HN: Those who applied to the OpenAI Grove program, did you ever hear back?
item.description:
📝 Link to the Grove program: https://openai. I never had high hopes of getting accepted, but never receiving confirmation of my application submission nor an email notifying me I wasn’t accepted came across as inconsiderate and unprofessional. I’m disappointed but not entirely surprised given the program felt both ambiguous (about what they were looking for) and very wide net being cast (“founders at the very earliest stages—whether you’re pre-idea, just starting out, or preparing to launch a company”).
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45637945
